Every tier includes the community and the VYRON Score. What changes above that is
        how much of the Academy you reach, and how much direct guidance you get.

Prices are set.What each tier contains is still being finalised and may change
        before launch— reserving records which one you want, it does not buy it.
        Core also runs at €490 a year; Elite at €399 for three months or
        €699 for six. Private is priced per person by the founders.

Built by three people doing the work themselves, not narrating it from the
        outside. No anonymous accounts and no borrowed screenshots.

Built numbers, not targets. No member count, no revenue and no performance
        figure appears here, because there is no honest one to give yet.

We could have built everything in silence and launched to an empty room. Instead
        the room is visible while it is being built: you can see exactly what is finished,
        tell us which tier to open first, and take something useful away today. That is
        the whole strategy.

We open when these are done, and not before.There is no launch date on
          this page because there is not one to give — and a date we missed would be
          a promise broken to the people who backed us earliest. The week we set it, this
          list hears it first.

Each of these is built into the platform rather than a chat group with a course
